questions.question: Explain why 1 m³ = 1 000 000 cm³.
questions.expected_answer: A cubic metre is 100 cm × 100 cm × 100 cm: 10 000 one-centimetre cubes per layer and 100 layers, giving 1 000 000 cm³.

questions.question: Convert 0,25 m³ to cm³, 4 200 cm³ to m³ and 840 mm² to cm².
A tank holds 5 000 l. What is its volume in m³, and how tall is it if its base is 2 m by 1,25 m?
questions.expected_answer: 5 000 l = 5 kl = 5 m³. Base area 2,5 m², so height = 5 ÷ 2,5 = 2 m.
